title: Stable highway driving
summary: Reviews in this topic praise the vehicle for feeling stable while driving, especially on highways, with a few mentions of steady overall performance and easy control.

positive.summary: Positive reviews describe confident highway stability, stable general driving feel, and in a few cases steady performance, easy operation, and secure cargo placement.

limitations: One fragment concerns boot storage keeping items stable rather than driving dynamics, so the topic is not perfectly uniform.
Examples are limited to short fragments, so details about the specific conditions or components behind the stable feel are insufficient.
